concepts.headline: PROBLEMS / SOLUTION: Ultrasonic Denture Cleaner
concepts.prompt: Recreate the layout of the SECOND attached image closely as a 4:5 ad: LEFT half white with the heading "PROBLEMS" in heavy black caps and three simple black line icons stacked vertically, each with a short bold black caps label under it: an icon of a stained tooth "YELLOW STAINS", an icon of bacteria "BACTERIA & ODOR", an icon of a glass with a fizzing tablet "OVERNIGHT TABLET SOAKS". RIGHT half deep navy (#0E283C) with the heading "SOLUTION" in heavy white caps, a small white rounded pill with dark script text "Ultrasonic Denture Cleaner", and a clean studio product photo of the white DentalPULSE Pod from the first reference image with a bright white clean denture beside it. Simple flat line icons only, no cartoon characters. IMPORTANT: the ONLY words in the image are the quoted texts above, each rendered exactly once and spelled exactly; no other text, no logos except the DentalPULSE wordmark where quoted and the wordmark printed on the Pod, no competitor names. POD RULES: the DentalPULSE Pod RESTS on a surface or is a clean product cut-out; NOBODY holds it. Compact bathroom-counter device about 13 cm wide and 8.5 cm tall, never a big machine. Any appliance is about HALF the Pod's width. Any stained denture is UNMISTAKABLY yellow-brown at first glance; a clean one has bright white teeth and fresh pink gums.
